description: Test suite for the ExecApprovalHelpers module, including tests for decision parsing, allowlist pattern matching, pattern validation, and ask requirement logic.

methods.name: parse decision trims and rejects invalid
methods.description: Tests parsing of decision strings into enum values, including trimming whitespace and handling invalid input.

methods.name: allowlist pattern prefers resolution
methods.description: Tests how command resolution influences the allowlist pattern, prioritizing resolved path over raw command.

methods.name: validate allowlist pattern returns reasons
methods.description: Validates that patterns are correctly identified as valid or invalid, with specific rejection reasons.

methods.name: requires ask matches policy
methods.description: Tests the logic determining if user prompts are required based on ask setting, security policies, and allowlist matches.
